<a id="page-lists"></a>
# Lists and data

Lists over data, grids, tables, paged views, reordering and swipe actions. Open it when a UI repeats a row per
element, lays out a grid, shows a table or pages through items.

<a id="lists-a-list-over-data"></a>
## A list over data

`each item in list` repeats the lines under it once per element: `{item.field}` reads it, `index` is its place. An
each inside an each is best given names of its own (`each group in groups` / `each msg in group.items`): the inner
lines read `{group.name}` and `{msg.subject}`. An inner each that reuses the outer's name (`each item in item.items`)
hides it, as in any language: `{item}` under it is the inner element, and `parent.item` the outer. A name inside a
string literal (`'m-' + m.id`) is text, never the loop's. An `if` under an `each` hides what a copy shows, not the
copy: the copy keeps its place in the list and its cell in a Grid. To leave elements out, repeat over the ones to
show: `each d in filter(days, x => x.open)`.

```notation
state rows=[{"name":"Ada","total":3},{"name":"Lin","total":5}]
Column gap=8
  each item in rows
    Row between
      Text "{item.name}"
      Text "{item.total}"
```

Writers' words for a grid, a table, a list put in order by hand and swiped pages, and what each reads as:

- Flutter's names on a Grid: `crossAxisCount` is `cols`, `crossAxisSpacing` and `mainAxisSpacing` are `gap` (a Grid
  has one), `mainAxisExtent=30` is each cell's height and `childAspectRatio=2` its width over its height.
- `ListView reorder handle onReorder={…}` is a list whose rows a `Handle` drags into a new order (`reorder` alone: a
  long press anywhere on the row).

```notation expands
state photos=["a","b","c"]
Grid cols=3 gap=8
  each item in photos
    Text "{item}"
```

It reads as:

```notation

Grid cols=3
  each item in photos
    Text "{item}"
```

A `Handle` is as big as its line says and where it is written: the list adds no room around it. Unwritten it is a
44 px target on a phone and a 24 px grip on a page 700 wide or wider (a touch still lands on it in 44 × 44).

`reorder` on an `each` (or on the line it is under) lets its copies be dragged into a new order, and moved with Alt
and the arrows from the keyboard. The new order is written to the list the `each` runs over, so that list is a
variable declared with `state`; over a formula (`each c in colCards(col.id)`) write `reorder onReorder={…}` on the
line the `each` is under and store the
move yourself (`result.item`, `result.from`, `result.to`, `result.toList`). Moving between lists (a board's
columns) is a `ListView`'s: `ListView#lane reorder.group=board reorder.listKey={col.id} onReorder={…}` with the
`each` under it; the `reorder.*` keys (`group`, `listKey`, `start=press`) are a ListView's, not a Column's.

```notation expands
  Text "Two"
```

<a id="lists-a-table-of-records"></a>
## A table of records

Rows of records with the same fields are a `Table`: `Table o in orders columns=[…]` writes a finished table, the
way a careful hand would: a frame on the theme's surface with a hairline on every side and rounded corners that
clip its rows, a header band (the labels in the caption's ink, a rule under it, kept in view while the page
scrolls), and a row per record with a rule under it and the band's fill under the pointer. Do not build a table
from a Column of Rows: write `Table`.

- `columns=[…]`: each column a label (`"Name"`: its key is `name`) or `{"key":…, "label":…, "w":120,
  "align":"end", "sort":false}`. A column with no `w` grows; `"align":"end"` puts its cells at the end in
  tabular figures (amounts, counts, dates in figures). `"hide":"phone"` leaves the column (its header and its
  cells) out on a phone, `"hide":"tablet"` on a tablet and a phone: one table serves every width. Reflow leaves a
  table as written; these are its rules at other widths.
- The lines under the Table are its cells, one per column in order, each reading the record by the Table's name
  (`{o.total}`, in every key: `color={o.status == 'Paid' ? … : …}`): a picture beside a name, a chip, a menu button.
  Columns left at the end with no line show their key's value.
- `sort=@sortKey` (a text variable, the key sorted by; `-key` the other way): a press on a header sorts by its
  column, again the other way; an arrow marks the column sorted, a quiet mark the others.
- `select=@chosen` (a list variable of the rows' `id`s): a column of checkboxes leads; the header's picks every row
  or none; a row is chosen by a press, Shift takes a range, Ctrl or Cmd adds, and is tinted with the accent.
- `compact` makes the rows denser (36 instead of 44), `comfortable` roomier (52); `h=400` gives the table a height
  its rows scroll in under the header; `empty="No orders match."` is said when there are no rows; `maxw=`, `w=`
  and the other keys of a Column are the frame's. A design system's own `Table` comes first.

```notation width=1280 expands
state orders=[{"id":"o1","name":"Ada Byron","status":"Paid","total":30},{"id":"o2","name":"Lin Chen","status":"Due","total":12}]
state search=""
state status="All"
state sortKey="name"
state chosen=[]
state shown:list={filter(orders, r => (status == 'All' || r.status == status) && contains(lower(r.name), lower(search)))}
Page
  Section
    Row gap=8
      Input "" "Search" @search w=280
      Select @status items=["All","Paid","Due"] w=140
    Table#orders o in shown columns=[{"key":"name","label":"Customer"},{"key":"status","label":"Status","w":120},{"key":"total","label":"Total","w":100,"align":"end"}] sort=@sortKey select=@chosen empty="No orders match."
      Row gap=10
        Avatar "AB" size=28
        Text.strong "{o.name}"
      Badge "{o.status}"
```

A table that scrolls on both axes and builds only the cells in view (a timetable, a sheet of thousands of cells) is
`DataTable rows={orders} columns=[…]` (`TableView`): every cell is a text of its key's value.

A table of your own (a Column of Rows) gets the same frame from the keys: `border=… radius=8 clip=antiAlias` on
the Column, `border-bottom=…` on each Row. A box's border is drawn over what it holds, so the rows' own fills
never cover its sides, and `clip` keeps them inside its rounded corners.

<a id="lists-a-list-of-its-own-line"></a>
## A list of its own line

A `ListView` or `GridView` line with an `each` as its only line under it repeats that one line over the data: the
list's own keys (its height, its direction, its spacing) are on its line.

```notation
state products=[{"name":"Lamp"},{"name":"Desk"}]
ListView h=120 scrollDirection=horizontal
  each item in products
    Text "{item.name}" w=100
```

<a id="lists-a-list-that-follows-its-newest-entry"></a>
## A list that follows its newest entry

`follow` on an each, with the height it scrolls in, is a log or a chat: `each line in lines follow h=180` opens at
its end and stays there as entries are added (the list's `stickToEnd`). `follow grow` takes the room its column
leaves instead of a height (a chat over its composer).

```notation
state lines=["Connected","Ready"]
Column gap=8
  each item in lines follow h=180
    Text "{item}"
  Button "Add" onTap={lines=append(lines,"Synced")}
```

The list the `each … follow` makes is a `ListView` of its own, so its events are written on the each line:
`onScroll={…}` (its `result`: `offset`, `max`, `viewport`, `fraction`, `index` the item at the start of the view,
`count`), `onScrollEnd={…}`. Once the reader scrolls up it draws its own jump-to-latest button at its bottom end. A
pill of your own that counts what arrived meanwhile reads the scroll: `away` while the reader is up from the end,
the count kept while away and cleared at the end, and the pill (in a `Stack` over the list) going back to the
last item with `scrollTo node=… item={…}`.

```notation expands
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","text":"Morning"},{"id":"m2","text":"Lunch today?"},{"id":"m3","text":"Yes, 12:30"},{"id":"m4","text":"Same place?"},{"id":"m5","text":"By the river"},{"id":"m6","text":"Perfect"},{"id":"m7","text":"See you there"},{"id":"m8","text":"Five late"},{"id":"m9","text":"No rush"},{"id":"m10","text":"Here now"},{"id":"m11","text":"Table by the window"},{"id":"m12","text":"On my way up"}]
state away=false
state unread=0
Column h=360 gap=8
  Stack w=fill grow
    Column w=fill h=fill
      each m in msgs follow grow onScroll={away = result.max - result.offset > 80; unread = away ? unread : 0}
        Text#msg "{m.text}" pad=12
    Row#latest visible={away and unread > 0} x={"align":0} y={"end":12} pad=[12,6,12,6] radius=16 fill=#FF2563EB onTap={scrollTo node=msg item={length(msgs) - 1}; unread=0}
      Text "{unread} new" color=#FFFFFFFF
  Button "Receive" onTap={msgs=append(msgs, {"id": "m" + (length(msgs) + 1), "text": "New message"}); unread = away ? unread + 1 : 0}
```

It reads as:

```notation
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","text":"Morning"},{"id":"m2","text":"Lunch today?"},{"id":"m3","text":"Yes, 12:30"},{"id":"m4","text":"Same place?"},{"id":"m5","text":"By the river"},{"id":"m6","text":"Perfect"},{"id":"m7","text":"See you there"},{"id":"m8","text":"Five late"},{"id":"m9","text":"No rush"},{"id":"m10","text":"Here now"},{"id":"m11","text":"Table by the window"},{"id":"m12","text":"On my way up"}]
state away=false
state unread=0
Column gap=8 h=360
  Stack h=fill grow
    Column h=fill
      ListView h=fill grow data={msgs} scrollable=true stickToEnd=true gap=0 onScroll={away=result.max - result.offset > 80; unread=away ? unread : 0}
        Column#listView1Item
          Text#msg "{item.text}" pad=12
    Row#latest pad=[12,6,12,6] x={"align":0} y={"end":12} fill=#FF2563EB radius=16 visible={away && unread > 0} onTap={scrollTo node=msg item={length(msgs) - 1}; unread=0}
      Text "{unread} new" color=#FFFFFFFF
  Button "Receive" onTap={msgs=append(msgs, {"id": "m" + (length(msgs) + 1), "text": "New message"}); unread=away ? unread + 1 : 0}
```

<a id="lists-scrolling-to-one-copy"></a>
### Scrolling to one copy

A line under an each is one line repeated, so it has one name: `Row#msg`, not an id worked out per copy (`id={m.id}`
is said and left out). A copy is reached by its item: `scrollTo node=msg item={key}` scrolls to the copy of the item
whose `id` is `key` (`item={3}`: the fourth item). A pinned message, a quote that goes to the message it quotes, a
search result: each names the item. A list that follows its end builds only the messages near its view; one not
built yet is built and scrolled to. An item no copy is of is said when the action runs, and nothing scrolls.

```notation expands
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","text":"We land on Thursday"},{"id":"m2","text":"Book the train"},{"id":"m3","text":"Done"}]
state pinId="m1"
Column h=300
  Row pad=12 fill=#FFF3F4F6 onTap={scrollTo node=msg item={pinId}}
    Text "Pinned: We land on Thursday"
  each m in msgs follow grow
    Text#msg "{m.text}" pad=12
```

It reads as:

```notation
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","text":"We land on Thursday"},{"id":"m2","text":"Book the train"},{"id":"m3","text":"Done"}]
state pinId="m1"
Column h=300
  Row pad=12 fill=#FFF3F4F6 onTap={scrollTo node=msg item={pinId}}
    Text "Pinned: We land on Thursday"
  ListView h=fill grow data={msgs} scrollable=true stickToEnd=true gap=0
    Column#listView1Item
      Text#msg "{item.text}" pad=12
```

<a id="lists-a-list-chosen-from-and-swiped"></a>
## A list chosen from and swiped

`selectable selected=@chosen` on the line an each is under makes its rows chosen as a desktop list's are (a press
alone, Ctrl or Cmd adds, Shift takes a range, Ctrl or Cmd A all), and `SwipeAction` lines under the each (an each
that runs down a Column, as below; not under a ListView) put actions behind a swiped row: one list takes both (a mailbox: choose many with the keyboard and the pointer, swipe one on a
phone). `removes` takes the row out of the list's variable; `result.item` is the row swiped. An action is drawn in
the accent, a destructive one (`danger`, or a delete, remove or trash by its icon or label) in the theme's error
color; `background=` and `foreground=` give it colors of its own (`background=warning`). A row's own menu
(`menu=rowMenu onRightClick={menuId=m.id}` on the row) opens on a right-click or a long press, and a press still
chooses the row; `menu=` on the list's line instead acts on the rows chosen.

```notation expands
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","subject":"Q4 review"},{"id":"m2","subject":"Lunch?"}]
state chosen=[]
Column selectable selected=@chosen
  each m in msgs
    Row h=56 pad=[16,0,16,0]
      Text "{m.subject}"
    SwipeAction "Archive" side=end icon="archive" onTap={msgs=without(msgs, result.item)}
    SwipeAction "Delete" side=end icon="delete" removes
```

It reads as:

```notation
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","subject":"Q4 review"},{"id":"m2","subject":"Lunch?"}]
state chosen=[]
state chosenAnchor:decimal=-1
Column
  ListView data={msgs} scrollable=false gap=0 swipeActions={"endActions":[{"id":"archive","label":"Archive","icon":"archive","removes":false,"background":"#FF2563EB","foreground":"#FFFFFFFF"},{"id":"delete","label":"Delete","icon":"delete","removes":true,"background":"#FFDC2626","foreground":"#FFFFFFFF"}],"apply":"variable"} focusGroup.axis=vertical focusGroup.wrap=false onKeyDown(key=mod+a)={chosen=map(msgs, x => coalesce(x.id, x)); announce "{length(chosen)} selected"} onSwipeAction(when={result.action=="archive"})={msgs=without(msgs, result.item)}
    Column#listView1Item selected={contains(chosen, coalesce(item.id, item))} onTap={chosen=(result.shift && chosenAnchor >= 0 ? map(slice(msgs, min(chosenAnchor, index), max(chosenAnchor, index) + 1), x => coalesce(x.id, x)) : (result.meta ? (contains(chosen, coalesce(item.id, item)) ? without(chosen, coalesce(item.id, item)) : append(chosen, coalesce(item.id, item))) : [coalesce(item.id, item)])); chosenAnchor=(result.shift && chosenAnchor >= 0 ? chosenAnchor : index); announce "{length(chosen)} selected"}
      Row pad=[16,0,16,0] h=56
        Text "{item.subject}"
```

<a id="lists-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-listView"></a>
### `ListView` (`listView`)

Flutter `ListView`; the first child is the item.

- Written `ListView`. Level 0 (Core).
- Takes no quoted string.
- The lines under it are its children. Slots: `loading`, `error`, `end`, `sectionHeader`, `reorderPlaceholder`.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrollDirection` | `horizontal` `vertical` | `vertical` | 0 | The axis it scrolls along. |
| `reverse` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 |  |
| `physics` | `platform` `bouncing` `clamping` `never` `rangeMaintaining` | `platform` | 0 |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 0 | Scrolls even when the content fits (`AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics`). |
| `primary` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 |  |
| `keyboardDismissBehavior` | `manual` `onDrag` | `manual` | 0 |  |
| `clipBehavior` | `none` `hardEdge` `antiAlias` `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` | `hardEdge` | 0 |  |
| `itemCount` | whole number |  | 0 | The number of items; null repeats the item without end (or one per value of the bound `data`). |
| `cacheExtent` | number (≥ 0) |  | 0 |  |
| `query` | JSON | `{}` | 0 | Where the items come from in a running app: a cloud query (`{"collectionPath", "limit", "whereFilters", "orderByFilters", "paging", "loadRelated", "statusVariable"}`). Runtime only. |
| `itemSnapping` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Each drag or fling comes to rest with an item at the start of the view (CSS `scroll-snap-type: mandatory` with `scroll-snap-align: start`), as PageView.pageSnapping does for pages: a carousel of cards. |
| `dragEdgeScroll` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 0 | Scrolls while a dragged node is held near its edges; off: stays put under a drag (a strip of tabs a card is dragged onto). |
| `scrollable` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 0 | False builds every item without a viewport when the count is known and the list hugs its items (or stretches them across a cross axis it hugs). |
| `itemExtent` | number (≥ 0) |  | 0 | Each item's extent along the scroll direction. |
| `separator` | `none` `space` `divider` | `none` | 0 |  |
| `gap` (or `spacing`) | number | `0` | 0 | The separator's extent; negative overlaps the items. Without a `separator` it is empty space (as a row's or column's spacing). |
| `dividerThickness` | number (≥ 0) | `1` | 0 |  |
| `dividerColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF000000` | 0 |  |
| `dividerIndent` | number | `0` | 0 |  |
| `dividerEndIndent` | number | `0` | 0 |  |
| `layout` | `list` `stack` `deck` | `list` | 0 |  |
| `reversePaintOrder` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Paints a layered list's items in the opposite order. |
| `itemPosition` | [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) |  | 0 | A `ListLayout.stack` list: where the item sits in the padded box when its x/y aren't bound. |
| `wrap` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Lays every item out in runs, as Flutter `Wrap`, each item at its own size. The runs go along `scrollDirection`: with the default `vertical` the items flow top to bottom and wrap into columns; for items side by side that wrap onto new rows set `"scrollDirection": "horizontal"`. For cards in equal columns from data, a `gridView` with `minCrossAxisExtent` is usually what is wanted. |
| `wrapSpacing` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | 0 |  |
| `runSpacing` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | 0 |  |
| `wrapAlignment` | `start` `end` `center` `spaceBetween` `spaceAround` `spaceEvenly` | `start` | 0 |  |
| `wrapCrossAlignment` | `start` `end` `center` | `start` | 0 |  |
| `stretchItems` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Every item as thick across the list as the thickest beside it. |
| `pagination` | [Pagination](#type-Pagination) |  | 0 | Loads the items page by page, with pull to refresh (its footers are the `loading`, `error` and `end` slots). |

The current page is at rest, pages between are interpolated by their distance (clamped to two pages) and pages before are mirrored (`translateX`, `shiftX`, `rotate`, `rotateY` and the alignment's x change sign). A `Pose`: a transform with an opacity and a blur. Null: flat pages. |

<a id="lists-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onReorder`](events.md#trigger-reorder), [`onRefresh`](events.md#trigger-refresh), [`onSwipeAction`](events.md#trigger-swipeAction), [`onRowTap`](events.md#trigger-rowTap), [`onSort`](events.md#trigger-sort).
- Actions: [`paginate`](events.md#action-paginate).

<a id="lists-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-Pagination"></a>
### Pagination

A pagination controller: loads a list's items page by page and exposes its state as a map variable named `name` (`${name.items}`, `${name.page}`, `${name.pageCount}`, `${name.hasMore}`, `${name.isLoadingMore}`, `${name.error}`...). Paginate actions move it.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `""` | The map variable that holds the state, unique on its page. |
| `mode` | `pages` `infinite` `bidirectional` | `infinite` |  |
| `source` | `data` `cloud` `api` | `data` |  |
| `pageSize` | whole number (≥ 1) | `20` |  |
| `pageSizeOptions` | list of whole number | `[10,20,50,100]` | The page sizes a pagination node offers; empty offers none. |
| `strategy` | `offset` `page` `cursor` | `offset` |  |
| `keyPath` | text | `"id"` | The path in an item of the value that identifies it; items with the same value show once. Empty keeps every item. |
| `initialPage` | whole number (≥ 1) | `1` | The page shown first, from 1. |
| `thresholdItems` | whole number (≥ 0) | `5` | How many items from the end (or start) the next page starts loading. |
| `thresholdPixels` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | The same in pixels of scroll left; 0 uses `thresholdItems` alone. |
| `cachePages` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Loaded pages are kept to show again until a refresh. |
| `apiId` | text |  | The API (`PaginationSource.api`). |
| `parameters` | JSON | `{}` | The API call's parameters (`${page.page}`...). |
| `itemsPath` | text | `""` | Where in an API response the page's items, the total count and the next cursor are (empty: the response itself, unknown, none). |
| `totalPath` | text | `""` |  |
| `cursorPath` | text | `""` |  |
| `pullToRefresh` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Pull to refresh (`RefreshIndicator`): the list's `refresh` reactions. |
| `refreshColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `refreshBackgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `refreshDisplacement` | number (≥ 0) | `40` |  |

<a id="type-ListSections"></a>
### ListSections

Groups a data list's consecutive items with the same `groupBy` value into sections, each under the list's `sectionHeader` slot.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `groupBy` | text | `""` | A path in the item (`group`, `date.day`) or an expression. |
| `sticky` | `true`/`false` | `true` | The current section's header stays pinned until the next pushes it out. |
| `indexBar` | `true`/`false` | `false` | An index of the sections' keys along the list's edge (A–Z). |
| `indexKeys` | list of text | `[]` | The keys the index shows, in order (`A`…`Z`); empty shows the sections'. A key no item has is drawn in `indexMutedColor` and does nothing. With a data-paged list the keys of every item count, and picking one loads pages until its section is in. |
| `indexStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The index's text (font, size, weight, color). |
| `indexActiveColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | A key while it is touched. |
| `indexMutedColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | A key no item has. |
| `indexWidth` | number (≥ 0) | `20` |  |
| `indexBubble` | `true`/`false` | `false` | The touched key pops up large beside the index while it is dragged. |
| `indexBubbleColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `indexBubbleStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  |
| `indexInsets` | list of number | `[0,0,0,0]` | Space between the index bar and the list's edges: left (unused), top, right, bottom. Zero sits it on the right edge, full height. |

<a id="type-ListReorder"></a>
### ListReorder

Dragging a list's items to a new place, within the list and, with a `group`, into other lists of the group (a Kanban board). A drop runs the list's `reorder` reactions with `${result.from}`, `${result.to}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}` and `${result.toList}`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `start` | `handle` `longPress` `press` | `handle` |  |
| `group` | text | `""` | Lists of one group take each other's items; empty: within this list. |
| `listKey` | text | `""` | This list in `${result.fromList}` / `${result.toList}` (an expression); empty: the list's id. |
| `canReorderIf` | text | `""` | Must hold for an item (`${item}`, `${index}`) to be picked up. |
| `canDropIf` | text | `""` | Must hold for a drop (`${result}` as the drop would be). |
| `proxyElevation` | number (≥ 0) | `6` |  |
| `proxyScale` | number (≥ 0) | `1` |  |
| `proxyOpacity` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` |  |
| `placeholder` | `gap` `node` | `gap` |  |
| `autoScroll` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `autoScrollEdge` | number (≥ 0) | `48` |  |
| `keyboard` | `true`/`false` | `true` | A focused item moves with Alt and the arrow keys, and is announced. |
| `apply` | `none` `variable` `cloud` | `none` |  |
| `orderField` | text | `"order"` | The numeric field of a document's position (`ListApply.cloud`). |
| `listField` | text | `""` | The field of the list a document is in, for moves between lists. |

<a id="type-SwipeAction"></a>
### SwipeAction

One action revealed behind a list item as it is swiped.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | `""` | The action in `${result.action}`. |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) |  |  |
| `background` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FFDB2626` |  |
| `foreground` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FFFFFFFF` |  |
| `removes` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Takes the item out of the list (delete, archive); otherwise it springs back. |
| `when` | text | `""` | Offered for an item only while this holds (an expression reading `${item}`, e.g. `${= item.done}`); empty: always. The first action of a side that holds is the one a full swipe runs. |
| `labelStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The label's text (font, size, weight; its color is `foreground`). |
| `iconSize` | number (≥ 0) | `22` |  |
| `inline` | `true`/`false` | `false` | The icon beside the label instead of above it. |

<a id="type-SwipeActions"></a>
### SwipeActions

Swipe actions on a list's items (`Dismissible`): toward the start reveals `endActions`, toward the end `startActions`; past `threshold` the first of the side runs. Running one fires the list's `swipeAction` reactions with `${result.action}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.index}`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `startActions` | list of [SwipeAction](#type-SwipeAction) | `[]` |  |
| `endActions` | list of [SwipeAction](#type-SwipeAction) | `[]` |  |
| `threshold` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0.4` | The fraction of the item's width a swipe passes to run the first action. |
| `undo` | `true`/`false` | `true` | An action that removes the item shows an Undo bar first. |
| `undoMs` | whole number (≥ 0) | `4000` |  |
| `undoMessage` | text | `"${result.label}"` | `${result.label}` reads the action's label. |
| `apply` | `none` `variable` `cloud` | `none` |  |
| `radius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `0` | The revealed actions' corners (round them to match the item's). |
| `armedScale` | number (≥ 0) | `1` | The action's label grows to this scale once a release would run it. |
| `armHaptic` | `true`/`false` | `false` | A selection click when a swipe passes the threshold either way. |

<a id="type-TableColumn"></a>
### TableColumn

One column of a table view: the row field its cells show (`key`, read as `${item.value}`), its header text (`label`, `${item.label}`) and its width (null: the table's `columnWidth`).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | text | `""` |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `width` | number (≥ 0) |  |  |
| `flex` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | The column's share of the room left when the table is wider than its columns (its width is then the least it takes); 0: fixed. |

<a id="lists-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="lists-example-list-json"></a>
### list.json

From [`list.json`](../lists.md).

```notation
state open=-1
state questions=[{"q":"Can I cancel any time?","a":"Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the period."},{"q":"Do you offer refunds?","a":"Within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked."},{"q":"Is there a free trial?","a":"Every plan starts with 30 days free."}]
canvas h=600
Column#col gap=12 scroll pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":600}
  Text.heading2#heading "Questions" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":30}
  ListView#items w={"fill":342} h={"hug":300} scrollable=false gap=8
    each item in questions
      Column#item gap=4 pad=12 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":60} fill=#FFF3F4F6 radius=8 onTap={open=open == index ? -1 : index}
        Text.strong#q "{item.q}" size=16 w={"fill":318} h={"hug":20}
        Text.muted#a "{item.a}" size=14 lineHeight=1.4 w={"fill":318} h={"hug":20} visible={open == index}
```

<a id="lists-example-table-view-json"></a>
### table_view.json

From [`table_view.json`](../lists.md).

```notation
state years=[{"year":"2023","trees":"3,120","survival":"94%"},{"year":"2024","trees":"4,480","survival":"91%"},{"year":"2025","trees":"4,880","survival":"87%"}]
canvas h=260
TableView#table w={"fill":390} h={"fill":260} data={years} rowHeight=40 headerHeight=40 pinHeaderColumn=false fillWidth=true columns=[{"key":"year","label":"Year","width":80},{"key":"trees","label":"Trees","width":100},{"key":"survival","label":"Survival","width":100}]
  slot cell
    Text#cell "{item.value}" size=14 color=#FF0F172A pad=[12,10,12,10] w={"fill":100} h={"fill":40}
  slot columnHeader
    Text#head "{item.label}" weight=700 color=#FF334155 pad=[12,10,12,10] w={"fill":100} h={"fill":40}
```

<a id="lists-example-pages-table-filter-json"></a>
### pages/table_filter.json

From [`pages/table_filter.json`](../lists.md).

```notation
state invoices=[{"num":"INV-1","cust":"Acme","amt":1200,"status":"Paid"},{"num":"INV-2","cust":"Globex","amt":850,"status":"Overdue"},{"num":"INV-3","cust":"Initech","amt":430,"status":"Paid"},{"num":"INV-4","cust":"Hooli","amt":675,"status":"Overdue"},{"num":"INV-5","cust":"Wonka","amt":520,"status":"Paid"}]
state search=""
state statusFilter="All"
state sortKey="num"
state desc=false
state page=0
state shown:list={sortBy(filter(invoices, r => (statusFilter == 'All' || r.status == statusFilter) && contains(lower(r.cust), lower(search))), sortKey, desc ? 'desc' : 'asc')}
state paged:list={slice(shown, page * 3, page * 3 + 3)}
state pages:integer={max(1, ceil(length(shown) / 3))}
canvas h=360
Column#col gap=8 pad=16 w={"fill":390} h={"hug":320} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Row#tools gap=8 w={"fill":358} h={"hug":48} crossAxisAlignment=null
    Input#search hint="Search customer" w={"fill":220} h={"hug":28} initialValue={search} onChange={search="{result}"; page="0"}
    Select#pick w=130 h={"hug":28} value={statusFilter} items=["All","Paid","Overdue"] isExpanded=true onChange={statusFilter="{result}"; page="0"}
  Row#head w={"fill":358} h={"hug":20} crossAxisAlignment=null
    Text#hCust "Customer" color=#FF6B7280 w={"fill":270} h={"hug":18} text={"Customer{sortKey == 'cust' ? (desc ? ' ↓' : ' ↑') : ''}"} onTap={desc="{sortKey == 'cust' && !desc}"; sortKey=cust}
    Text#hAmt "Amount" color=#FF6B7280 w={"hug":80} h={"hug":18} text={"Amount{sortKey == 'amt' ? (desc ? ' ↓' : ' ↑') : ''}"} onTap={desc="{sortKey == 'amt' && !desc}"; sortKey=amt}
  ListView#list w={"fill":358} h={"hug":108} scrollable=false
    each item in paged
      Text#row "{item.num}  {item.cust}  {item.status}  {item.amt}" size=15 w={"fill":358} h=36
  Row#pager w={"fill":358} h={"hug":40}
    Text#count "" color=#FF6B7280 w={"fill":198} h={"hug":18} text={length(shown) == 0 ? 'No invoices match' : (page * 3 + 1) + '–' + min(page * 3 + 3, length(shown)) + ' of ' + length(shown)}
    Button.ghost#prev "Prev" w=80 h=40 onTap={page=max(0, page - 1)}
    Button.ghost#next "Next" w=80 h=40 onTap={page=min(pages - 1, page + 1)}
```

<a id="lists-example-pages-weekly-json"></a>
### pages/weekly.json

From [`pages/weekly.json`](../lists.md).

```notation
state habits=[{"name":"Water","days":[true,true,false,false,false,false,false]},{"name":"Read","days":[false,true,false,false,false,false,false]}]
canvas h=400
Column#col pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":400} crossAxisAlignment=null
  ListView#habitList w={"fill":342} h={"hug":200} scrollable=false gap=12
    each row in habits
      Column#habit gap=6 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":70}
        Text#name "{item.name}: {count(item.days, d => d)}" size=15 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20}
        gridView#week w={"fill":342} h={"hug":40} shrinkWrapRows=null cols=7 mainAxisExtent=40 crossAxisSpacing=6 physics=never
          each item in item.days
            box#day h={"fill":40} fills=[{"color":"#FFE5E7EB"}] fill={item ? '#FF16A34A' : '#FFE5E7EB'} radius=20 w={"fill":40} onTap={habits="{setAt(habits, parent.index, set(parent.item, 'days', setAt(parent.item.days, index, !item)))}"}
```

<a id="lists-example-carousel-json"></a>
### carousel.json

From [`carousel.json`](../lists.md).

```notation
state current=0
state progress:decimal=0
state products=[{"name":"Linen apron","price":48,"color":"#FFD6CFC4"},{"name":"Moss bowl","price":36,"color":"#FFB7C4A1"},{"name":"Oak board","price":72,"color":"#FFC9A27E"},{"name":"Clay cup","price":22,"color":"#FFE3B5A4"},{"name":"Wool throw","price":120,"color":"#FFA9B4C2"}]
canvas h=520
Column#page gap=16 pad=[20,24,20,24] w={"fill":390} h={"fill":520}
  Row#header between w={"fill":350} h={"hug":40} crossAxisAlignment=null
    Text.heading2#heading "New arrivals" size=22 w={"hug":160} h={"hug":28}
    Row#arrows gap=8 w={"hug":96} h=40 crossAxisAlignment=null
      IconButton#prev "chevron_left" w=40 h=40 enabled={current > 0} onTap={scrollTo node=card item={current - 1} axis=horizontal durationMs=300}
      IconButton#next "chevron_right" w=40 h=40 enabled={current < length(products) - 1} onTap={scrollTo node=card item={current + 1} axis=horizontal durationMs=300}
  ListView#rail w={"fill":350} h=300 scrollDirection=horizontal gap=16 itemSnapping=true onScroll={current="{result.index}"; progress="{result.fraction}"}
    each item in products
      Column#card gap=6 w=240 h={"fill":300}
        box#cardArt w={"fill":240} h=220 fills=[{"color":"#FFE7E5E4"}] fill={item.color} radius=8
        Text.strong#cardName "{item.name}" size=15 w={"fill":240} h={"hug":20}
        Text.muted#cardPrice "${item.price}" size=14 w={"fill":240} h={"hug":20}
  Row#footer gap=16 w={"fill":350} h={"hug":10} crossAxisAlignment=null
    ListView#dots w={"hug":90} h=8 scrollDirection=horizontal scrollable=false gap=6
      each item in products
        box#dot w=8 h={"fill":8} fills=[{"color":"#FFD1D5DB"}] fill={index == current ? '#FF111827' : '#FFD1D5DB'} shape=circle onTap={scrollTo node=card item={index} axis=horizontal durationMs=300}
    Stack#track w={"fill":200} h=4 fill=#FFE5E7EB radius=2
      box#trackFill w=0 h=4 fill=#FF111827 radius=2 widthFactor={progress}
```

```notation
ListView#sections w={"fill":600} h={"hug":400} scrollable=false gap=24
  each row in groupBy(dishes, 'section')
    Column#section w={"fill":600} h={"hug":200}
      Text#sectionTitle "{item.key} ({item.count})" size=20 w={"fill":0,"hug":200} h={"hug":24}
```
